verdict.rationale: Docusign documents its own workflow automation: configurable workflows (docusign-docs-4), IAM-platform workflow automation (docusign-docs-45), and a drag-and-drop editor for designing contract processes (docusign-docs-17). Risk-Based Verification also automatically changes the verification step based on an instant risk assessment (docusign-docs-26). However, none of the evidence explicitly describes user-defined event→action rules, such as triggers on envelope completion or status changes. MCP-driven 'trigger workflow actions' is agent-invoked, not event-driven, and form conditional logic is an adjacent feature, so neither is credited. missing for 10: explicit event-triggered rule definition (trigger types, conditions, actions), documentation of automation triggers on agreement lifecycle events, independent or hands-on corroboration.
